title: Concept: Reverse proxy target assembled from a request variable in nginx — review required
description: In nginx, the proxy target contains a variable. nginx will use whatever the variable resolves to, so a request that influences it can select the backend. That turns the proxy into an SSRF primitive with access to everything the nginx host can reach, including link-local metadata.
applicability: nginx reverse proxies with dynamic backends.
risk: Access to internal services through the proxy; MEDIUM severity.
